name: LiveAgent
description: LiveAgent is a customer-support platform for ticketing, live chat, call center workflows, knowledge bases, customer portals, service routing, automation, and reporting.
agentUseSummary: Enter one customer-owned LiveAgent account domain and API v3 key, then let selected agents use content-free ticket operations or approved documented API v3 requests under Safe or Dangerously skip permissions.

credentialRequirements.name: LIVEAGENT_DOMAIN
credentialRequirements.label: LiveAgent account domain
credentialRequirements.helpText: Enter the exact ladesk.com or liveagent.com hostname for your LiveAgent account.

credentialRequirements.name: LIVEAGENT_API_KEY
credentialRequirements.label: LiveAgent API v3 key
credentialRequirements.helpText: Create an API v3 key with only the ticket read permissions needed for bounded reads; broader operations require corresponding provider permissions.

capabilities.label: Read ticket operations
capabilities.description: List and inspect bounded ticket operational metadata without subjects, messages, notes, contacts, names, email addresses, phone numbers, custom fields, tags, attachments, or raw records.

capabilities.label: LiveAgent API v3
capabilities.description: Use documented API v3 paths and methods allowed by the connected LiveAgent API key.

approvalRequired.label: List ticket metadata
approvalRequired.description: List one fixed first page of content-free LiveAgent ticket summaries.

approvalRequired.label: Read ticket metadata
approvalRequired.description: Read one exact LiveAgent ticket through Relay's content-free operational projection.

approvalRequired.label: Use API v3
approvalRequired.description: Use a documented LiveAgent API v3 operation authorized by the connected API key; Safe mode requires approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Content-free ticket reads and every broader API v3 operation require approval; account-domain binding, secret isolation, provider permissions, and bounds remain enforced.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Selected key-authorized operations run without Relay per-action approval; account-domain binding, secret isolation, bounds, audits, provider permissions, and LiveAgent limits still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts typed wrappers and attaches the encrypted API key only to the validated LiveAgent account API v3 origin.
Railway mounts typed wrappers and attaches the encrypted API key only to the validated LiveAgent account API v3 origin.

providerSetup.blocker: A customer LiveAgent account domain and API v3 key with selected permissions are required for live acceptance.
providerSetup.nextAction: A customer creates a minimally permitted API v3 key, enters the account domain and key in Relay, and verifies bounded reads, Safe approval, Dangerous broader-operation behavior, key rotation/invalidation, and disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: LiveAgent's official API-key guide documents API v3 keys, per-key permissions, the apikey request header, and the tenant /api/v3/tickets endpoint.
LiveAgent's official documentation guide locates API v3 documentation under each YOURDOMAIN.ladesk.com tenant and requires a generated API v3 key with matching permissions.
LiveAgent documents limits for API v3 ticket retrieval and recommends narrower filters; Relay independently caps its bounded ticket-list wrapper at 25 records and one page.
